repositories.description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
repositories.description_zh: 面向 AI coding agents 的上下文窗口优化工具，可大幅压缩工具输出、持久化会话记忆，并通过 MCP 和 hooks 管理多平台路由。

repositories.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
repositories.description_zh: 易用的 AI 交互界面，支持 Ollama、OpenAI API 等模型和服务。
Microsoft 官方的 1-bit LLM 推理框架，用于高效运行低比特大语言模型。

repositories.description: Use Claude Code, Codex, VSCode, Pi, and OpenCode (and 6 other harnesses) for free (1.3B+ free tokens) from your terminal, app, IDE, or phone, and now from the browser with native browser sessions (multi-harness + multi-model) like OpenClaw (voice supported + ToS friendly)
repositories.description_zh: 从终端、App、IDE、手机或浏览器免费使用 Claude Code、Codex、VSCode、Pi、OpenCode 等多种 harness，支持多模型、原生浏览器会话和语音。

repositories.description: An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft Word in pure Rust
repositories.description_zh: 用纯 Rust 从零实现的开源 Microsoft Word 重构项目。

repositories.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
repositories.description_zh: 用 agents 逆向分析各种目标，从应用行为到原生二进制都能覆盖。

repositories.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
repositories.description_zh: 运行在浏览器里的侦察卫星模拟器，使用真实开源空间情报数据，在逼真的 3D 地球上展示实时态势。

repositories.description: ArtCraft is an intentional crafting engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers
repositories.description_zh: ArtCraft 是面向艺术家、设计师和电影创作者的可控创作引擎。

repositories.description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, and Pi. 44 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
repositories.description_zh: 面向 Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot、Cursor、Factory Droid 和 Pi 的编辑式图表设计方案，包含 44 种图表类型，输出自包含 HTML + SVG。

repositories.description: AirLLM 2.8T LLM inference with single 4GB GPU
repositories.description_zh: AirLLM 支持在单张 4GB GPU 上进行 2.8T LLM 推理，适合低显存大模型部署和推理优化场景。
